title: Why this price?
summary: Every shop, market, property and exchange price, and the extra coin an NPC asks for in barter, now has a Why this price? button that shows how the price is made, in whole copper.
items: The breakdown lists the list price, the shop's markup or buy rate, the paying character's Charisma ("Aria negotiates: Charisma 16, 6% off") and the quantity, and its total is exactly what the purchase charges.
The DM also sees the black-market premium and how the season and realm conditions build a list price; players see those only as Other adjustments.
Shop rows now show the same price the purchase charges for characters whose Charisma is on their sheet.
